prompt: [Lecture homework example] Run Bubble Sort on [6, 4, 9, 3]. Give the final sorted array as JSON.
Besides proving the output array is sorted, what OTHER property must a Bubble Sort correctness proof establish about the relationship between input A and output A'?
acceptedAnswers: A' is a permutation of A
it's a rearrangement of the same elements
explanation: A' must contain exactly the same elements as A (same length, same multiset of values) -- otherwise a sorted array of the WRONG values would trivially satisfy sortedness alone.
